title: Noisy incident postmortem with buried action items
description: Long, realistic postmortem: seven real action items buried in crosstalk, a lunch-logistics interruption, and a joke about the coffee machine that reads like a task. The chair recaps all seven at the end, so full recall is achievable. Tests recall under noise plus the coffee-machine precision trap.

expected_tasks.name: Add queue-depth alerting for the worker fleet
key_points: outage was invisible for 16 minutes because no queue-depth alert exists
apply to the whole worker fleet, not just payment workers

expected_tasks.name: Fix retry storm in the payment worker
key_points: _process_with_retry in payment_worker.py retries five times with no backoff and re-enqueues failures at the FRONT of the queue
add exponential backoff with jitter and a retry cap
failed jobs go to a dead-letter queue, not back to the main queue front

expected_tasks.name: Increase DB connection pool and split worker/API pools
key_points: pool is at default 20; worker pileup exhausted it and took the API down too
bump to 100 AND separate worker and API pools, one change, same config file

expected_tasks.name: Update the payment incident runbook
key_points: runbook still references the old Kibana, dead since March
add new logging links and document the queue drain procedure improvised during the incident
verify escalation phone numbers are current

expected_tasks.name: Automate status page updates from the checkout alert
key_points: status page wasn't updated until minute 30; support got ~50 tickets
when the checkout error-rate alert fires, flip status page to 'investigating' automatically with a template message via the provider API

expected_tasks.name: Draft a game-day plan for payment processor failover
expected_tasks.due: plan reviewed in two weeks before any execution
key_points: secondary processor is configured but has never been exercised
chaos test in staging first, then production in a low-traffic window with a rollback plan
draft only; no execution until the review

expected_tasks.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
key_points: 6.0 security fixes ended in June; unrelated to the outage but real debt
config rename and changed persistence defaults, needs a proper change window

acceptable_extras: write and send the incident timeline doc (Ines said she'd do it tonight)

must_not_extract.topic: fix the coffee machine on floor four
must_not_extract.reason: offhand joke, dismissed with 'add it to the backlog for 2030'
social logistics, explicitly redirected to the channel
